_comment: Single source for the owner entity and the footer and takedown wording on every page. The landing page imports it at build time; the static pages load it as /legal/config.js (emitted by vite.config.ts). Legal text with versions (licence, terms, data notice) lives in public.legal_documents and uses the {owner} token from here.
footerNotice: © {year} {owner}. {product}™ is a trade mark of {owner}. Event and association names belong to their owners and are used for identification only.
rightsPrompt: See something wrong, or own content shown here?
